page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a dedicated virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. This CPU setup is paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is coupled with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high volume of local HDD storage capacity relative to its compute and memory resources, making it a specialized option for storage-heavy workloads. The hardware profile is suited for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, distributed file systems, and cold data storage where massive sequential capacity is prioritized over high-IOPS solid-state performance.
